Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Italian trainings identified in teatro di figura all belong to private or association bodies outside the denominator: the two-year academy of the Centro Teatro Internazionale in Florence, the Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria attached to the Perugia festival, the Animateria pathway, the Universita dei Burattini in Cesenatico. The only foothold in public education is the Teatro di figura subject taught within the scenography course of the Academy of Fine Arts in Catania: a subject in a curriculum, not a specialised training, and so it does not satisfy the denominator. No specialised degree was found. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the check not having covered the curricula of every academy of fine arts and national drama school. Italy is the case the schema explicitly flags as understated by an institutional indicator.
